Name: Fish Bonanza
Author: Kehaan
Description:
Feel like "[b]Stardew Valley[/b]" is not having a lot of fish? Then this mod is for you. This is the "[b]Stardew Valley[/b]" version of the "[b]Minecraft[/b]" mod "[url=https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fish-bonanza]Fish Bonanza[/url]" This mod is using "[url=https://www.curseforge.com/stardewvalley/mods/content-patcher]Content Patcher[/url]" and is required for the mod to run.
This version adds currently [b]75 new fish to the game[/b], and just as with the one for Minecraft, the plan is to add more fish over time.

I mainly release my Stardew Valley mods and modpacks on CurseForge. You can find many more of my projects here: [url=https://www.curseforge.com/members/kehaan/projects]https://www.curseforge.com/members/kehaan/projects[/url]

[list]
[*]75 new fish[/*]
[*]Spawn in different places around the world, in different seasons and different times.[/*]
[*]More fish will be added in future updates.[/*]
[*]Each fish have a price, some worth more than others.[/*]
[*]i18n support for translations files (Currently English, French (by vin163) and Chinese translations is included)[/*]
[/list][img width=867,height=306]https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/968/959/stardewmoddingapi_su5g1vs6as.png[/img][img width=878,height=311]https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/968/960/stardewmoddingapi_dttsxkyep5.png[/img]
[b]There is currently the following fish:[/b]
[i]Addis Butterflyfish, American Lobster, Angelfish, Atlantic Cod, Atlantic Salmon, Betta, Billfish, Bitterling, Black Sea Bass, Bluefish, Butterfish, Califonia Sheephead, Char, Clown Triggerfish, Cobia, Copper Banded Butterflyfish, Crucian Carp, Dace, Dab Drums, Emperor Angelfish, Flame Angelfish, Flatfish, Frog, Goldfish, Gray Triggerfish, Grouper, Haddock, Hake, Hammerhead Shark, Horse Mackerel, Jack, King Salmon, Koi, Loach, Mackerel, Mahi Mahi, Monkfish, Mullet, Oarfish, Olive Flounder, Opah, Pale Chub, Parcula Clownfish, Piranha, Pollock, Porgies, Purple Sailfin Tang, Ray, Redfish, Reticulated Dragonet, Shark, Seahorse, Skate, Snapper, Striped Bass, Surgeonfish, Sweet Fish, Tadpole, Tautog, Tilefish, Turbot.
[/i]
[i]Update 1.1.0, adds the following new fish Chillipepper Rockfish, Cowcod, Cusk, Flat Needlefish, Golden Trout, Ladyfish, Rainbow Runner and Swordfish.[/i]
